description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) for a confidential opportunity in Baltimore County, MD. This full-time role offers a competitive salary range of $115,000 - $145,000 per year at a premier skilled nursing facility committed to providing exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be instrumental in overseeing all operational aspects of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, and driving continuous improvement in quality of care and resident satisfaction. This is an excellent opportunity for a visionary leader to make a significant impact within a reputable organization.
requirements: Current and valid LNHA license in Maryland
Proven experience as a Licensed Nursing Home Administrator in a skilled nursing setting
Strong leadership and operational management skills
In-depth knowledge of state and federal regulations for skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation between $115,000 and $145,000 per year, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This vital role involves ensuring accurate and timely completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, which are crucial for resident care planning and facility reimbursement.

The successful candidate will play a key role in coordinating the interdisciplinary care team, conducting comprehensive assessments, and maintaining compliance with all federal and state regulations related to MDS. This position offers an opportunity to significantly impact resident outcomes and facility operations.

This is a full-time opportunity with a competitive annual salary. We are looking for a committed professional to join our team permanently.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa.
Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator, preferably in a skilled nursing facility.
Strong understanding of MDS 3.0, Medicare, and Medicaid regulations.
Excellent assessment, documentation, and communication skills.
Candidates seeking interim positions will not be considered.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $65,000 to $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
